name: tinymce-self-hosted-monorepo
description: Proof of concept: self-hosted TinyMCE 8 (GPL) shared between an AngularJS 1.x app and a Vue 3 app, wired up via npm postinstall.

scripts.copy:all: npm run predev -w apps/angularjs-app && npm run predev -w apps/vue3-app
scripts.update:tinymce: npm install tinymce@latest -w apps/angularjs-app -w apps/vue3-app && npm run copy:all
